title: P31 Agent Capability Manifest
description: Declares what an agent needs from a model — capability buckets, not model names. Never lock an agent to a model.

agentId.description: Unique agent identifier referenced by loadInstructionSet()

capabilities.description: Capability labels the model must provide (e.g. tool-calling, structured-json, code-generation, deep-reasoning, vision)

bucket.description: Capability bucket resolved by the L1 capability router. Not a model name. Examples: fast-code, deep-reasoning, structured-json, summarize, vision, local-sovereign

maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum acceptable end-to-end latency in ms

toolPermissions.description: Local tool names the agent may invoke

mcpAllowlist.description: MCP server names the agent may call

modelName.description: FORBIDDEN. Manifests reference buckets, never model names.
